about: The SNPs that consumer fitness DNA tests report, for sport_snps.py. This list only chooses which variants to show and groups them; what each one does and how strong the evidence is comes from Ensembl VEP, the GWAS Catalog, ClinVar, ClinPGx and Europe PMC. ACE rs4343 stands in for the ACE insertion/deletion, which genotyping chips can't read. meaning, for the variants that matter in practice: what carrying 0, 1 or 2 copies of the changed allele means, by its copies.

meaning.0: Both copies make alpha-actinin-3, the protein that stiffens fast-twitch fibres for explosive force: the genotype most common among elite sprinters and power athletes.
meaning.1: One copy makes alpha-actinin-3, enough for the fast fibres to have it: common among both power and endurance athletes.
meaning.2: Neither copy makes alpha-actinin-3, the protein that stiffens fast-twitch fibres for explosive force. The fast fibres work without it and behave a little more like slow ones: this genotype is rare among elite sprinters and more common among endurance athletes. For everyday training it matters little; strength still responds normally to lifting.

meaning.0: Both copies make AMP deaminase, the enzyme that keeps muscle energy flowing in hard, repeated efforts.
meaning.1: One copy of AMPD1 is broken, so the muscle makes less AMP deaminase. This usually goes unnoticed; if hard intervals bring early cramps or fatigue, longer warm-ups and rest between efforts help.
meaning.2: Both copies of AMPD1 are broken: the muscle lacks AMP deaminase. Many people with this have no symptoms; some get cramps, pain or early fatigue in hard exercise. Longer warm-ups, pacing and rest between efforts help.

meaning.0: Both copies are the slower form of CYP1A2, the enzyme that clears caffeine: caffeine lasts longer for you. Smaller doses taken early in the day protect sleep and recovery.
meaning.1: One fast and one slower copy of CYP1A2, the enzyme that clears caffeine: caffeine is cleared at an in-between pace. Keep it to the first half of the day to protect sleep.
meaning.2: Both copies are the fast, inducible form of CYP1A2, the enzyme that clears caffeine: caffeine is cleared quickly, faster still in heavy coffee drinkers. Take it 30 to 60 minutes before training.

meaning.1: One copy of C282Y, the main haemochromatosis variant. Carriers rarely build up iron on their own, but it adds to iron from food and supplements: don't take iron unless a test shows you need it. Ferritin and transferrin saturation show where you are.
meaning.2: Two copies of C282Y: the genotype behind most hereditary haemochromatosis. Ask for ferritin and transferrin saturation; iron overload is easy to treat when found early.

meaning.1: One copy of H63D, a mild HFE variant: on its own it rarely matters for iron.
meaning.2: Two copies of H63D, a mild HFE variant: iron can run slightly higher. A ferritin test is worth it before taking iron.

meaning.1: One copy of MTHFR 677T: the folate enzyme runs a little slower. Folate from leafy greens and legumes covers it.
meaning.2: Two copies of MTHFR 677T: the folate enzyme runs at about a third of the usual pace, and homocysteine can rise when folate is low. Eat folate-rich food (greens, legumes) daily; a homocysteine test shows whether it matters for you.

meaning.1: One copy of the FTO allele linked to higher body weight and appetite. Regular physical activity reduces its effect on weight by about a third (Kilpeläinen 2011).
meaning.2: Two copies of the FTO allele linked to higher body weight and appetite. Regular physical activity reduces its effect on weight by about a third (Kilpeläinen 2011), so exercise pays off more than average for you.
